d:
Bhide loses sleep caught between Jethalal and Sodhi, as both insist on buying Chandiramani's flat. Jethalal lectures Bhide on "justice" because he gave the first token amount to Madhavi, while Sodhi claims full right after handing his token to Bhide.
Step into Jethalal’s world with Gada Electronics! Manage the shop, tackle quirky customers, and experience nonstop TMKOC-style fun.
Are you ready for the challenge?
